title: Circular - eGujHC - Calling for suggestions on paperless working of the Court and the Registry - High Court of Gujarat
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 03/07/2024
Date: 03/07/2024 REGISTRAR (SCMS & ICT)

FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CELL
CIRCULAR
(No. ITC/759/2024)
Date: 03/07/2024
Online webpage inviting suggestions from all the stakeholders for
VISION DOCUMENT ON
SEAMLESS END TO END PURE PAPERLESS E-MODE OF WORKING
of the Courts and the Registry of the High Court of Gujarat
Under the guidance of Hon'ble the Chief Justice, High Court of
Gujarat, a vision document is being prepared for a full fledged software
suite and portal, viz. "eGujHC", for seamless end to end e-mode of
working for the High Court of Gujarat as paperless Courts as well as
paperless Registry.
Presentation cum interaction sessions with various stakeholders
have been held wherein a gist of all the salient aspects and features of
the draft vision document has been elaborately shared, while also
inviting suggestions for further enhancements of features and
functionalities to be added in the draft vision document being prepared.
As Hon'ble the Chief Justice has been pleased to further direct to
facilitate online submission of suggestions by the stakeholders, an online
web page has been developed and made available at
https://gujarathighcourt.nic.in/suggestions for the same.
Stakeholders may visit the aforesaid web page and share their
innovative suggestions for further enhancements to be incorporated in
the vision document for end to end pure paperless e-mode of working of
the Courts and the Registry in the High Court of Gujarat. The
stakeholders may also indicate about the applicable
rules/regulations/directions/circulars etc. that may have to be amended
for implementation of the suggested innovations.
Date: 03/07/2024 REGISTRAR (SCMS & ICT)
To: All concerned.
